versions.name: Fishing
versions.description: Rig rod and reel, tie the clinch, Palomar, uni, and arbor knots, pick lures or bait to match the water, then catch a fish, identify it, and clean and cook it or release it safely.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
